name: Beknur Karimov-Ergashev
role: Investigative journalist and whistleblower handler operating out of Mexicantown Libre
location: Mexicantown Libre, GLMZ, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Beknur Karimov-Ergashev has the kind of face that is easy to remember individually and hard to place in a crowd â€” broad nose, angular cheekbones, warm coppery-brown skin, and dark eyes that are always, always taking notes. She keeps her thick dark hair pulled back tightly and wears it down only when she is trying to go unnoticed, which is an inversion most people would not anticipate. She has a faint artificial shimmer to the skin of her forearms â€” a residual effect of a cheap bioluminescence mod she had installed and removed years ago, leaving this iridescent ghost behind.

Beknur Karimov-Ergashev spent seven years at a mid-tier Zheng-Dao affiliated media outlet before she published a piece they hadn't approved and found herself without a desk, a salary, or a press credential. Now she freelances for a network of independent outlets under three different bylines and runs an encrypted communication service that connects corporate whistleblowers with journalists, lawyers, and occasionally mutual aid networks depending on what is needed. She is funny and genuinely charming at parties, which is a professional tool she is not always comfortable with. She keeps a running list of every piece that has been killed, delayed, or changed without her consent â€” it is very long, and she re-reads it when she needs to remember why she is doing this.

core_fears: Getting a source killed or imprisoned
Publishing something wrong â€” not just inaccurate but genuinely unjust, used against an innocent person
core_desires: A story so thoroughly documented that it is legally and institutionally unassailable
To stop having to be charming for access and just be trusted for her work
coping_mechanisms: Compartmentalization â€” separates 'Isadora the professional' from feelings about what she witnesses
The running list of killed stories, which functions as both wound and motivation
blind_spots: Tends to view everyone in her orbit as a potential source, which strains actual friendships
Her charm and social fluency make people underestimate how calculating she is being in any given conversation â€” including people who should know better, including herself
psychology.secret: One of her whistleblowers, a mid-level Axiom logistics manager, gave her information that she verified and prepared to publish â€” and then received a credible threat against her younger brother in the Kamm's Landing district. She sat on the story for six weeks. The whistleblower, who had no idea why publication was delayed, was eventually identified internally and quietly disappeared into a Axiom HR 'reassignment.' She does not know what happened to them. She has published the story since, under a byline that was not her primary one.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fluid and adaptable â€” can match register to almost any conversation partner. Her own voice, unperformed, is dry and direct and occasionally brutal.
speech_patterns.cadence: Variable. Slows way down when asking important questions. Can maintain a comfortable, unhurried social pace for hours.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last few words of something someone said back to them as a question, very gently
Says 'Help me understandâ€”' instead of 'I disagree'
example_lines: 'Help me understand what Ferrogate's compliance office thought they were doing when they filed those environmental exemptions. I'm sure there's a very reasonable explanation. I would love to hear it on record.'
'I've been called a muckraker twice this week. I'm starting to think it's a compliment they're too angry to mean as one.'

story_hooks: The disappeared Axiom whistleblower contacts her through her encrypted drop â€” they are alive, in a private Axiom 'wellness facility,' and want out, but extraction requires information she would have to obtain illegally.
She has documentation of an event that directly involves someone a player character cares about â€” and she is deciding whether to publish, and what she needs before she does.
narrative_function: Information broker, source of corporate intelligence, quest giver whose assignments carry ethical weight, character who can pull threads from multiple storylines together.
augmentations: Residual bioluminescent shimmer on forearms (cosmetic artifact from removed mod). High-quality optical implant â€” this one she saved for, bought new, no lag â€” which records continuous video and stores sixty hours of encrypted footage locally before auto-purging. A subvocal microphone implant for discrete recording.
daily_life: Attends three to four public events or meetings weekly as 'background research,' spends mornings managing the encrypted whistleblower drop system, afternoons writing, evenings at the Libre's community social spaces maintaining the relationships that are the actual infrastructure of her work.
affiliation: Independent (three active bylines); informal network of whistleblower contacts across Axiom, Zheng-Dao, and Ferrogate Transit; working relationship with Reuben Osei-Mukherjee-Å»ak (shares sources occasionally)

decision_rules: Verify everything with at least two independent sources before publication
Never reveal a source's identity â€” this is absolute, including after publication, including under legal pressure
escalation_ladder: Quiet information gathering and relationship building
Formal records requests and public information filings
If publication is suppressed â€” distribution through underground networks and Frequency-type press
If personally threatened â€” dead-man's-switch data release pre-arranged with trusted contacts

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and curious and excellent at making people feel interesting. The curiosity is real even when the warmth is strategic.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and more honest than comfortable. Will tell you something you don't want to hear. Bad at small talk with people she actually trusts.

stress_responses.low: Throws herself into the next story
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very controlled and performance-level charming with everyone, which is its own warning sign to people who know her
stress_responses.high: Stops eating, stops sleeping, and writes â€” compulsively, not publishably, just to get the shape of something down

contradictions: Committed to transparency as a civic good and routinely operates through strategic concealment and persona management
habits: Keeps three physical notebooks with identical covers, labeled with a personal code system
Has a ritual of leaving a micro-data offering at Mexicantown Libre's E.L.F. shrine â€” always a corrupted file, always a story that was killed â€” 'for safekeeping'
breaking_points: If she becomes certain that sitting on a story has directly resulted in someone being harmed, she will publish immediately, without her usual verification rigor, and deal with the consequences afterward â€” this is the version of her that scares her

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian (51.7%) as dominant ancestry, blended with South Asian (24.9%), creating the foundation of warm medium-brown skin with golden and olive undertones. Hispanic/Latin American (14.5%) adds warmth and depth to complexion, while Middle Eastern (3.6%), Sub-Saharan African (3.0%), and Eastern European (2.3%) contribute subtle undertonal complexity and skin luminosity. This Ubiquitous Diaspora combination results in a warm, sun-kissed medium-brown tone with a distinctly Silk Road influence.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with subtle musculature; carries herself with the economical movement of someone who has learned to be unobtrusive. Long-limbed, narrow shoulders.
physical_description.hair_style: Typically pulled back in a tight, functional bun or braid; worn down only as deliberate camouflage
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm undertone, slightly almond-shaped from Central and South Asian ancestry blend
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones and subtle olive notes â€” the result of Central Asian and South Asian dominance (76.6% combined) creating a sun-kissed base, enhanced by Hispanic/Latin American warmth and depth, with Middle Eastern luminosity and Sub-Saharan African richness adding complexity.
physical_description.complexion: Moderately prominent nose with gentle definition at bridge and nostrils, characteristic of Central and South Asian heritage; defined cheekbones with balanced width across face from Central Asian ancestry; sharp jawline with slight softness at the chin. Eyes sit at medium depth with subtle almond shape. Skin is clear and well-maintained but shows signs of chronic sleep debt â€” faint darkening beneath eyes. Expression tends toward observant stillness, mouth held in a slight, private half-smile.
distinguishing_marks: Faint, iridescent shimmer visible across both forearms in certain light â€” residual artifact from removed bioluminescent mod, creating an almost oil-on-water effect that catches LED and natural light differently
Thin scar along the left temple, approximately 2cm, barely visible unless light hits it directly â€” old injury, well-healed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The forearm shimmer is the only immediately visible augmentation; it reads as unusual cosmetic work rather than active chrome. Her optical implant is subcutaneous; no visible mechanical eye or lens. Subvocal implant is completely invisible to casual observation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, efficient economy â€” no wasted gestures. Sits with her body angled slightly away from direct confrontation, shoulders relaxed but spine straight. Makes sustained eye contact when listening; her gaze is the kind that people recognize as 'taking you in.' Often has a pen in her hand or tucked behind her ear. Habit of writing notes on her palm with a stylus.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 professional-casual with deliberate understatement. Favors neutral colors (charcoal, deep teal, muted rust) and layered pieces that allow quick adaptation to different social contexts. Typically wears fitted but not fashionable trousers, long-sleeved shirts or fitted turtlenecks (covers the forearm shimmer in formal settings), and a worn leather jacket â€” vintage pre-2200, supple from use, bearing subtle scuffs and creases that suggest it has survived situations. Comfortable, quality shoes built for walking. Minimal jewelry: a thin silver ring on her right hand, a watch that is slightly too expensive for her current income (saved-for purchase). No corporate logos or brand signifiers. Clothes read as 'someone who needs mobility and anonymity,' not 'someone who needs to be noticed.'
